# dodopayments_brands (Data Source)

Lists brands.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_brands" "example" {
  max_items = 10
}

output "brands" {
  value = data.dodopayments_brands.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Set to true to also list archived brands. Default false.
- `max_items` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The brands that the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Time the brand was archived. Null for an active brand.
- `brand_id` (String)
- `business_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `image` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `reason_for_hold` (String) Incase the brand verification fails or is put on hold.
- `statement_descriptor` (String)
- `support_email` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `verification_enabled` (Boolean)
- `verification_status` (String)
